```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 10
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```


```{r set-directories}

```

# Load data

```{r}
NEO_full <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full.gt", 
                    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full")
```

# QC

## Filter Loci

```{r}
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% group_by(population)
loci_report_m <- qc_report_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% ungroup()

# filter loci
to_keep <- which(loci_report_m$hwe_p > 0.01)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep))
count_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% select_loci_if(loci_missingness(genotypes) < 0.05)
count_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% select_loci_if(loci_maf(genotypes) > 0.025)
count_loci(NEO_full)
```

## Filter Individuals

```{r eval = FALSE}
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(indiv_missingness(genotypes) < 0.1)

# temporarily remove all populations with only one individual before relatedness QC
pop_tbl <- table(NEO_full$population)
to_remove <- which(pop_tbl == 1)
to_remove_pops <- names(to_remove)
removed_pops <- NEO_full %>%
  filter(population %in% to_remove_pops)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(!population %in% to_remove_pops)

# remove relatives
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <-
  qc_report_indiv(NEO_full, kings_threshold = 0.0884)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% ungroup()
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)

# bind data together again
NEO_full <- rbind(NEO_full, removed_pops, backingfile = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_clean")
```

# Impute

```{r}
NEO_full <- gt_impute_simple(NEO_full, method = "mean")
```

# LD clumping

```{r}
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(NEO_full,
  thr_r2 = 0.2, size = 100,
  return_id = TRUE, use_positions = TRUE
)
NEO_full_ld <- NEO_full %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(NEO_full_ld)
count_loci(NEO_full_ld)
```

# Group

```{r}
NEO_full_ld <- NEO_full_ld %>% group_by(population)
```

```{r}
NEO_full_ld <- gt_update_backingfile(NEO_full_ld,
```


# Using K = 10

```{r}
qmat_10 <- get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 10, run = 1)

tidy_q_10 <- tidy(qmat_10, data = NEO_full)

mean_per_pop_10 <- tidy_q_10 %>% 
  group_by(group, q) %>%
  reframe(mean_percentage = mean(percentage))

wide_data <- mean_per_pop_10 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = q, values_from = mean_percentage, values_fill = 0) %>%
  # make all .Q columns numeric
  mutate(across(starts_with("Q"), as.numeric))

wide_data_no_group <- wide_data %>% select(-group)
```

# K means clustering

```{r}
# Decide how many clusters to look at
n_clusters <- 20

# Initialize total within sum of squares error: wss
wss <- numeric(n_clusters)

set.seed(123)

full_out <- list()

# Look over 1 to n possible clusters
for (i in 1:n_clusters) {
  # Fit the model: km.out
  km.out <- kmeans(wide_data_no_group, centers = i, nstart = 20)
  full_out[i] <- km.out
  # Save the within cluster sum of squares
  wss[i] <- km.out$tot.withinss
}

# Produce a scree plot
wss_df <- tibble(clusters = 1:n_clusters, wss = wss)
 
scree_plot <- ggplot(wss_df, aes(x = clusters, y = wss, group = 1)) +
    geom_point(size = 4)+
    geom_line() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)) +
    xlab('Number of clusters') +
    ylab("Within Cluster Sum of Squares") +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept = wss, 
        linetype = 'dashed')


scree_plot
```

7?

```{r}
# Select number of clusters
k <- 7
set.seed(123)
# Build model with k clusters: km.out
km.out <- kmeans(wide_data_no_group, centers = k, nstart = 20)
wide_data_no_group$cluster <- factor(km.out$cluster)
```

If a population has 15 or fewer individuals, then find populations with the same maximum Q at k = 10 and k = 20 to suggest merging.

@TODO is 15 the right threshold? 10? 20? How large should the populations be to get sensible z-scores?


```{r}
neo_pops <- NEO_full %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  reframe(N = n())

neo_pops$max_Q_k_10 <- max_per_pop_10$q
neo_pops$max_Q_k_15 <- max_per_pop_15$q
neo_pops$max_Q_k_20 <- max_per_pop_20$q


small_pops <- function(x, neo_pops){
  # get the name of the population
  pop_name <- x["population"]
  
  if (as.integer(x["N"]) < 10) {
    # check which populations share the same max_Q_k_10 
    population_info <- neo_pops %>%
      filter(max_Q_k_10 == x["max_Q_k_10"] & max_Q_k_20 == x["max_Q_k_20"] & max_Q_k_15 == x["max_Q_k_15"] & population != pop_name)
    if(nrow(population_info) > 0){
      return(population_info$population)
    } else {
      return("Nothing to merge")
    }
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
  
}

neo_pops$merge_names <- apply(neo_pops, 1, FUN = small_pops, neo_pops = neo_pops)
neo_pops
```

```{r}
length(which(neo_pops$merge_names == "Nothing to merge"))
length(which(!is.na(neo_pops$merge_names)))
```

K-means clustering to put into populations for f-stats

# Use metadata to consider merges...?

The metadata contain 111 populations - the data in the 'Only African' dataset in Fortez-Lima et al 2023. I suspect we have some data data from the 'Full-genotyped' dataset as this contains '81 populations with sample sizes lower than 10 individuals' because the metadata mostly cover populations with > 10 individuals.

```{r}
# dat2 contains all populations in EGAS50000000006, even those without coordinates
dat2 <- as.data.frame(read_excel("/home/EJC199/Git/malagasy_diversity/data/raw/data_input/41586_2023_6770_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx", sheet = 2))
colnames(dat2) <- dat2[1, ]
dat2 <- dat2[-1, ]
# rename the 'Only-Africa dataset' column
colnames(dat2)[which(colnames(dat2) == "Only-Africa dataset")] <- "Africa"
# include only entries in Africa
dat2 <- dat2 %>%
  filter(Africa == "Yes")
```

```{r}
neo_pops$lon <- ifelse(neo_pops$population %in% dat2$`Population label`,

```

# Add country and a $new_group column to neo_pops

```{r}
neo_pops$country <- sapply(strsplit(neo_pops$population, "_"), `[`, 1)
neo_pops$new_group <- NA
neo_pops$new_group <- ifelse(is.na(neo_pops$merge_names), neo_pops$population, neo_pops$new_group)
```

# Start combining populations by hand

## Angola

All Angola populations have Khoe-San languages (KSP): Khwe, Xun, Sekele, and Vasekele grouped here

```{r}
neo_pops$new_group[neo_pops$country %in% c("Angola")] <- "Angola_K_V_S_X"
```

# Tanzania Mixed

Tanzania_TanzaniaMixed and Tanzania_Mixed appear to be the same population, and share .Q10 and .Q15 profiles. Tanzania_Mixed is only one individual.

```{r}
tan_mixed <- subset(neo_pops, neo_pops$population == "Tanzania_TanzaniaMixed")
neo_pops$new_group[neo_pops$population == "Tanzania_Mixed"] <- tan_mixed$new_group
```

# Mozambique

```{r}
mozambique <- subset(neo_pops, neo_pops$country == "Mozambique")
mozambique$merge_names
```

Tswa-Ronga/Tsonga are the same language group - part of a southern Bantu branch
Tswa and Ronga share .Q profiles k10, k15, k20
Tsonga shares .Q profiles k10 and k20 with Ronga and Tswa

```{r}
neo_pops$new_group[neo_pops$population %in% c(
                                         "Mozambique_Tswa",
                                         "Mozambique_Ronga",
                                         "Mozambique_Tsonga")] <-"Mozambique_Tsonga"
```




```{r}
# remove rows with missing lat/lon
dat2 <- dat2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))
# transform to sf object
dat2 <- st_as_sf(dat2, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
# make sample size numeric
dat2$N <- as.numeric(dat2$N)

# add coordinates to neo_pops based on matching population labels
neo_pops_na_omit <- neo_pops %>%
  filter(population %in% dat2$`Population label`)

dat2$`Bantu Group` <- ifelse(dat2$`Bantu Group` == "-", NA, dat2$`Bantu Group`)
dat2$poss_group <- ifelse(!is.na(dat2$`Bantu Group`), dat2$`Bantu Group`, dat2$Group)
table(dat2$poss_group)

neo_pops_na_omit$group <- dat2$poss_group[match(neo_pops_na_omit$population, dat2$`Population label`)]

dat_sep <- dat2 %>%
  mutate(lat = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         long = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# rename `population label` to population in dat_sep
colnames(dat_sep)[which(colnames(dat_sep) == "Population label")] <- "population"


# add geometry to neo_pops_na_omit based on matching population labels
neo_pops_na_omit <- neo_pops_na_omit %>%
  left_join(dat_sep[, c("population", "lat", "long")],
    by = c("population")
  )

neo_pops_na_omit <- st_as_sf(neo_pops_na_omit,
  coords = c("lat", "long"), crs = st_crs(4326)
)
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s05_b_fastmixture_africa.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  output_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)
print(sessionInfo())
```
